transcript.text: Recently, humare jhar ke dining area ka interiors humne finish kiya hai. Us space mein sabkuch premium aur modern lag raha tha, lekin waha par laga hua ek arm sa ceiling fan, kore room ka premium wipe kharab kar raha. Aur isse le finally mainne yeh Atomberg Harris Control ceiling fan order kiya hai. Dabba kolti hai, iska premium aur sleek design, such mein stand out karta hai.
